summary: Read an integer list that stays unmodified for the whole process. Many range questions follow. Each question gives two indexes i and j, with i less than or equal to j. Add every element whose index runs from i through j, including both ends, and write that sum. Between questions, every element keeps the value it had at the start.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
